In the last 7 days no band or smartwatch wrote heart rate, sleep or blood oxygen to Health Connect. The phone can\'t measure these, so they can\'t be collected without a band or watch.
Health Connect needs Android 9 or later. Band data can\'t be read on this phone.
Health Connect isn\'t on this phone. On Android 13 and earlier it\'s installed from the Play Store; Android 14 and later include it.
Choose the brand of your band or watch:
Mi Band and Xiaomi watches pair with Mi Fitness. In Mi Fitness → Profile → Health Connect, turn it on and allow all data types. If you use Zepp Life, check its settings for a Health Connect option.
Galaxy Watch and Galaxy Fit work with Samsung Health. In Samsung Health → Settings → Health Connect, allow sharing your data.
Pixel Watch and Fitbit devices work with the Fitbit app. Turn on syncing with Health Connect in the Fitbit app\'s settings.
In Garmin Connect settings, open Connected Apps → Health Connect and turn it on.
Huawei Health doesn\'t write to Health Connect at the moment, so data from Huawei and Honor watches can\'t reach FitWren.

Look for a Health Connect option in your watch\'s app (for example Wearfit Pro, Da Fit, FitCloudPro). If the app isn\'t listed under Health Connect → App permissions, it can\'t send data. Apple Watch only works with an iPhone.
Turn on the switch below to read band data. Health Connect will ask which data we may read.

string-array.name: release_notes_0_12_0
string-array.item: Band notifications: pick apps and set quiet hours; FitWren reminders also vibrate on the band
Band battery: on the device card, in the new \"Band battery\" widget and a phone alert when low
Find my phone (the band rings the phone) and Find my band; a phone alert when the band disconnects

string-array.name: release_notes_0_11_0
string-array.item: Band notifications: app notifications, incoming calls and music control on the band (Xiaomi). No ongoing notification; works with notification access
While connected, steps and health data sync over the same connection every 15 minutes

string-array.name: release_notes_0_10_0
string-array.item: Health tab redesigned: last night\'s sleep, a separate card for each metric and daily history charts (7, 30, 90 days). Settings are grouped; the connected band is at the top and Today has a \"Sync\" button

The license is now AGPL-3.0: the band connection is based on Gadgetbridge\'s code

Mi Band 2–6 and Amazfit (Bip, GTS, GTR and others) can connect directly too (experimental); the key is fetched in the app with your Zepp Life / Amazfit account

Get steps from a Xiaomi or Amazfit band without its app

FitWren connects to the band over Bluetooth itself and reads the steps directly. Mi Fitness and Health Connect are not needed.

Tested: Xiaomi Smart Band 8. Experimental (not tried yet): Band 8 Active, Band 8 Pro, Band 9, Band 9 Pro, Band 7 Pro, Redmi Smart Band 2, Redmi Band Pro, Redmi Watch 2 / 2 Lite / 3 / 3 Active / 4 / 5 Active / 5 Lite, Mi Watch Lite, Mi Watch Color Sport, Xiaomi Watch S1 / S1 Active / S1 Pro / S3. Older models used with Zepp Life are experimental too: Mi Band 2–6, Amazfit Band, Bip, GTS, GTR, T-Rex, Neo, Zepp E. Their key comes from the Zepp Life account (on a computer: github.com/argrento/huami-token).

The band connects to one app at a time. After you get the key, uninstall Mi Fitness from the phone. Do not remove the band inside Mi Fitness, or the band resets and the key changes.
Get the key with your Xiaomi account
Xiaomi\'s own sign-in page opens. Sign in with the account you use in Mi Fitness and confirm. FitWren never sees your password.
Or scan this code with the Xiaomi Home app on another phone.

For Mi Band 2–6 and Amazfit. Enter the e-mail and password you use in Zepp Life. The password goes only to Zepp\'s server; FitWren does not store it. This does not work if you sign in to Zepp Life with a Xiaomi account.
Zepp sign-in failed. Check the e-mail and password and try again.
The connection stays open without an ongoing notification. FitWren needs notification access for this.
Notifications that make a sound go to the band. A notification cleared on the band is also cleared on the phone.

Notification access is off. Turn on FitWren in Android settings.
If the connection drops on Xiaomi phones: Settings → Apps → FitWren → turn on Autostart and remove battery restrictions.
Works only with Xiaomi bands and watches for now.

The band is protected by a key tied to your Xiaomi account. You need to get the key once on a computer:
1. On a computer, download and open token_extractor.exe from github.com/PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor.
2. Sign in with the Xiaomi account you use in Mi Fitness.
3. When it asks for a region, leave it empty and press Enter.
4. Find your band in the list. Enter the 32-character code from the TOKEN line here.
The key must be 32 characters (0-9, a-f)
